## Audit round 2 — p4 (Ex. 1.0)

All three round-1 defects are fixed. I re-measured rather than trusting the corrections.

**[1.1] blocking → resolved.** `answer.tex:188–205` rewritten. I made two fresh crops of my own 300 dpi render of page 13. Every value in the new text matches: Barrelfish ~10.3k at 2 cores and flat to ~5; Linux ~5.2k, Windows ~5.8k; 17.5k / 29.5k / 46k at 32 cores; ratios 1.70 / 5.67 / 7.93. The conclusion is now correctly inverted — "did not reduce the constant cost… roughly *doubled* it and bought a much flatter curve" — and tied to the authors' own concession at `multikernel_sosp2009.txt:1128–1131`, both quoted fragments verbatim. The Summary paragraph was updated in step (17k→17.5k, 29k→29.5k), so the two halves no longer disagree, and grep finds none of the stale round-1 phrasings.

The worker also volunteered a correction I hadn't raised: the Linux crossover is ~12–13 cores, not 12–16. I checked it — with axis ticks visible, Barrelfish runs above Linux through core 11, they coincide at 12–13, Linux is clearly above from 14. The tightened claim is right.

**[1.2] → resolved.** Now "the abstract's opening sentence announces a ``multiprocessor operating system kernel''" — exactly what `mach_usenix1986.txt:10` says.

**[1.3] → resolved.** 10 / 16 / 20 in both `downloads.md` and `submission.md`, matching `pdfinfo`.

**New checks, nothing found.** I spot-checked four claims I hadn't reached in round 1 — the Linux 951 Mbit/s comparison (`:1783`), "twice as many updates per second as all 16 shared-memory threads combined" (`:372`), one-phase commit for unmap vs two-phase for capability retyping (`:1038`, `:1048`), and the SKB's "subset of first-order logic" (`:1065`). All verbatim correct. Rebuilt in both my wrappers: exit 0, 0 overfull/underfull boxes. Labels all `p4:`, R5 clean, lint OK, 3083 words with both required halves per paper.

The one residual is inherent, not a defect: Figures 6 and 7 publish no data table, so those values are graph reads good to ~±0.5k cycles. The worker states that exposure and hedges every such number; the claims carrying the argument are unambiguous at 300 dpi.

VERDICT: PASS
